Twelve-byte leaf body is 'bti c; mrs x0, S3_4_C15_C10_6; ret'. S3_4_C15_C10_6 is KERNEL_CNTVCTSS_EL0 (osfmk/arm64/machine_routines.c:2457), the non-speculative virtual counter, so the original symbol is ml_get_hwclock. AppleM2ScalerCSCDriver imports it through GOT slot 0xfffffff0080b55f8; the next boot panicked from AppleM2's start path with a stale x30 in its __DATA and an uninitialised x0, matching a no-argument counter read. Native ml_get_hwclock returns the same virtual timebase (isb + CNTVCT_EL0), so the binding is semantically equivalent; it also avoids the Apple CNTVCTSS alias, which Gunyah need not implement.

AppleM2ScalerCSCDriver's start path calls this no-argument reader from 0xfffffff0090a8af0 and uses low bits of the result as a modulo-5 state index in a 100-iteration retry loop. The original body reads two runtime function pointers at 0xfffffff007deb768/0x7deb770 and a node at 0xb822f30; the 12377 native __DATA_CONST placement overwrites those addresses with _bootstrap_pagetables, and a 55%-shape search over the native kernel found no equivalent. The device shim returns state 0 so the driver does not call the unmapped stub; it is a bring-up workaround, not a port of the 13432 reader.

Sixteen-byte getter: bti c; cbz x0; ldr x0,[x0,#0x4e8]; ret. The native 12377 _get_thread_ro_unchecked at __TEXT_EXEC+0x7fd744 is bti c; ldr x0,[x0,#0x4e8]; ret, the same field from the native thread layout; the original adds only a null check. AppleM2's trace path calls it with the current thread, so the binding is semantically equivalent.

AppleM2ScalerCSCDriver's last stubbed import: it zeroes the caller buffer (x1, size w2), looks up a string by the key in x0, and copies object+0x55c into the buffer. No 12377 function matched above 0.55 in the relocation-masked search. The device shim zeroes a valid buffer and returns NULL, the no-property path; the known call site ignores the return. Call-site registers in the panic had x1=0, so the shim also checks for NULL.

Sandbox import: bti c; cbz x0; ldrb w8,[x0,#0x2c]; (else w8=14); lsl w8,#-1; mvn w0,w8; ret. It returns (1<<shift)-1, an alignment mask from the kalloc_type view. The emitted native __DATA_CONST placement overwrites the view (target 0x7e87c58 is native data), and no 12377 equivalent was paired. The device shim returns the original fallback mask 0x3fff (16 KiB); this is a bring-up workaround, revisit if sandbox reports a size/alignment fault.

Sandbox callback target: validates an index against original pmap/VM tables at 0x7de5e30/0x7de5e90/0x7debdd0, multiplies by (0x4000 - (x2 & 0x3fff)), and calls 0xb411164 only on mismatch. The tables are overwritten by the native __DATA_CONST placement and no 12377 equivalent was paired. It has no writes, so a no-op is a safe bring-up shim; revisit if a real pmap consistency failure is suspected.

The XnuPrelink map already paired this exact original body to native _zalloc_ro (0x7390630). The native _zalloc_ro is the same-source allocator; bind by raw-byte hash.
